spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light.

spans.text: [22] AR: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"

[23] AR: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ EN: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allah, our Lord, we were not those who associated."

spans.text: [3] AR: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ EN: And He is Allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth.

folded.id: and he|is|the hearing
folded.subject: and He

spans.text: [13] AR: ۞ وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ EN: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

folded.id: and he|is|the subjugator over his servants
folded.subject: And He

spans.text: [18] AR: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: And He is the subjugator over His servants.

[21] AR: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ EN: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses?

folded.id: and he|is|the wise

spans.text: And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all].

folded.id: and that|is|the clear attainment
folded.subject: And that

spans.text: And that is the clear attainment.

folded.subject: And We
folded.object: [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them

spans.text: And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.

folded.subject: and We
folded.object: have covered them with that in which they cover themselves

spans.text: [9] AR: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًۭا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًۭا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ EN: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves.

folded.id: belongs whatever|is|in the heavens and earth?"
folded.subject: belongs whatever

spans.text: [12] AR: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُل لِّلَّهِ ۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۚ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?"

folded.id: but there|is|going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule
folded.subject: but there

spans.text: [5] AR: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ EN: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.

spans.text: [6] AR: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًۭا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ EN: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you?

folded.subject: He

spans.text: He has decreed upon Himself mercy.

spans.text: [9] AR: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًۭا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًۭا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ EN: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves.

spans.text: [7] AR: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًۭا فِى قِرْطَاسٍۢ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muhammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic."
But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved.

spans.text: [2] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍۢ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًۭا ۖ وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ EN: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute.

spans.text: [11] AR: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ EN: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light.

[23] AR: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ EN: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allah, our Lord, we were not those who associated."

folded.id: there|is|no remover of it except him
folded.subject: there
folded.object: no remover of it except Him

spans.text: [17] AR: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍۢ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ EN: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him.

folded.subject: this Qur'an
folded.object: revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches

spans.text: And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches.

folded.subject: This

spans.text: Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe.
Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe.

folded.subject: We would

spans.text: [9] AR: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًۭا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًۭا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ EN: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves.

folded.id: what thing|is|greatest in testimony?"
folded.subject: What thing

spans.text: [19] AR: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَٰدَةًۭ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ ۚ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ EN: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?"

folded.id: which there|is|no doubt
folded.subject: which there

spans.text: He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt.

folded.id: while it|is|he who feeds and is not fed?"
folded.subject: while it
folded.object: He who feeds and is not fed?"

spans.text: [14] AR: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّۭا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ ۗ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ EN: Say, "Is it other than Allah I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and the earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?"

folded.id: whom it|is|averted that day - [allah] has granted him mercy
folded.subject: whom it
folded.object: averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy

spans.text: [16] AR: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ EN: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy.

folded.id: whom we|have|given the scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons

folded.object: given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons

spans.text: [20] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons.

[25] AR: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۚ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness.

folded.id: why|was|there not sent down to him an angel?"
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: there not sent down to him an angel?"

spans.text: [8] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌۭ ۖ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًۭا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ EN: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?"
